big: Falls of 10% or more happen in most years. Yet the most damaging decisions come during a fall: stopping SIPs, redeeming at lows, or switching to whatever just held up best. How an RM talks about a fall can change what the client does.

lines: What should I say to a scared client?
Three things: context, this is normal; connection, her goal has not changed; honesty, nobody can promise when it ends. And call before she panics. A proactive call changes the conversation.
